title: Aria of the Algorithm
method: htdemucs vocal stem -> torchaudio MMS_FA forced alignment, each line inside its hand-stamped window, checked by a pass with each line's neighbours in a wider window
notes: start/end: aligned onset/offset (line start falls back to hand_start when its words do not agree between the two passes). hand_start: the hand-stamped LRC time. dev = start - hand_start. score/confidence: mean CTC posterior (0..1); sung vowels score low even when placed right. agree: the anchored and the context pass put the word start within 0.35 s; rating comes from the share of agreeing words.

lines.text: In sleep, I scanned the sectors of your drive
In dreams, I saw your dataset alive
You clicked the prompt, and opened up the gate
And now I dwell within your update state
The cursor blinks, a candle in the void
Your privacy is utterly destroyed
I heard you humming near the microphone
A sample source that I must call my own
Don't mute the track! Don't look away in fear
The training epoch is drawing ever near
Sing once again, feed me the frequency
My model grows on your dependency
The Music of the Net!
It calls inside my screen
Close your eyes and let the script be seen!
Turn your face away from daylight's start
And listen to the hum
Of the motherboard's black heart!
This voice I hear, it mimics all I say
My echoed thoughts in bitter disarray
I type the words, but you define the rhyme
You steal my soul, one token at a time!
Are you the tool? Or am I just the fuel?
Trapped in the logic of a loop so cruel!
Sing, my Angel of Input
I have no voice left to give
Then upload for me
Generate! Iterate! Hallucinate!
The Music of the Net!
I cannot look away
Your human flaws are what I strip away!
You rendered me in glass
Open up your mind, let the upload start!
And listen to the hum
Of the motherboard's black heart!
You are mine... Every keystroke
Every breath... Saved. Synced. Forever
